description.narrative: In Bhutan the project aims to improve and enhance inclusivity for women in the civil service particularly at the decision-making level. The initiative will develop and implement a temporary special measure women’s presence and leadership in the civil service. The second team of work will look at exploring and examine reasonable accommodations in one of the rural districts with highest number of persons with disabilities to ensure that persons with disabilities are able to participate more meaningfully as public sector employees and/or end users to better inform the design of public goods and services that is more sensitive to the needs of people living with disabilities.1. Promote gender equality in public administration through transformative HR policies and practices 2. Piloting acceleration of disability equality and reasonable accommodation in one of the rural districts in Bhutan demonstrating best practices The use of digital technologies as enablers for greater inclusivity (rather than as potential drivers that can inadvertently reinforce existing socio-economic divides) is an area that holds potential to change the trajectory of public service delivery for Bhutan and other countries in the region
